steps.description:
Write a program that calls a function to perform the following: 1. Set the thickness of the circle outline to be 6 pixels. 2. Draw a circle of any size. Use "green" colour for the circle outline and fill the inside of the circle with "yellow" colour. 3. Draw a square of any size. Use "purple" colour for the square outline and fill the inside of the square with "pink" colour. Your circle and square should not overlap.

Test Output
